new_regression_scope: Exact historical signed-run timestamp shapes in both drain arrival orders, true reverse timestamp straddle and overlapping pair fixed point, with the unchanged strict 50ms comparator.
Inclusive millisecond cutoff alignment and boot-origin fail-closed guard; deferred records stay outside positive signed coverage.
Captured fields retained, emitted probe sequence contiguous, bounded pending capacity, explicit read/cap/loss/missing-clock/late-record uncertainty and restart isolation.
Actual CollectorSigner and RuntimeSink empty/deferred-to-flushed-to-empty continuity, exact coverage endpoints and explicit successful read recovery without backfilling fault windows.

required_external_gates: Execute the genuine agent workflow on capable disposable synchronized Linux; cross-target lint is not runtime validation.
Run Linux live sensor tests; unavailable capability is reported separately, while an opened sensor must capture required events within the bounded follow-up cycles.
Re-evaluate the complete original signed actual workload window with the strict collector and offline verifier; do not shift its start, trim historical tails or weaken matching.
unchanged_limits: No durable resend: a send/ACK failure can leave a gap. Retention and once-only publication refer to the successful publication/ACK path, not crash-safe delivery.
Forward realtime jumps while monotonic time advances are not newly detected by this fix; clock discontinuity qualification remains incomplete.
Observer events are host-wide and independent process measurements; logical tool-to-kernel causality and logical subagent attribution are not established by PID/self-report alone.
No claim of separate administrative custody, host-compromise resistance, production approval or Linux installation qualification follows from these tests.
